claims.statement: Label guide declares FPT/GHEC/GHES, with discussion labeling only FPT/GHEC conditional. Labels are repository-local; definition changes do not affect labels in other repositories. EMU GHEC enterprise-only mutation qualifier applies.
Creating/editing/deleting definitions requires repository write; applying/dismissing requires triage. Definition management and assignment authorities must not be conflated.

Ten defaults accessibility, bug, documentation, duplicate, enhancement, good-first-issue, help-wanted, invalid, question and wontfix are supplied to new repositories but editable/deletable and organization-owner customizable. Names/descriptions are platform starting points, not universally adopted obligations.
Good-first-issue contributes to repository contribute-page discovery; label presence does not prove safe/appropriate newcomer task, independent review or completion.
Shared creation/edit steps specify name, optional description/color with randomizer and explicit Create/Save. Presentation color/name cannot establish semantic equivalence or permission enforcement.

Deleting definition removes assignments from issues and PRs. Discussion assignment deletion effects are not stated despite cloud discussion support; recovery/recreation guarantees absent and remain unknown.

Duplicate/invalid/wontfix labels classify work but do not establish audited equivalence, automatic closure or accepted completion. Label changes can trigger external automation so actual installed workflows must be considered before authorized mutation.
